Video Script Outline Generator

Plan your video fast — enter a topic and length to get a structured outline with hook options, intro, key points, and CTA.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your video topic and pick a length.
  2. Press Generate Outline.
  3. Copy the full outline or adapt it freely.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What video lengths are supported?

Short (1–3 min), medium (5–10 min), and long (15+ min) — the number of key points scales with length.

What does the outline include?

Three scroll-stopping hook options, an intro framework, main talking points, and a closing call to action.

Can I copy the whole outline?

Yes — a Copy Full Outline button copies the entire script plan at once.
